SHARMAH: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Umanand Island at Guwahati, Assam is
facing erosion problem for the last several
years;
(b) if so, what steps Government are
taking to protect the Umanand Island; and
(c) the details of financial allocation made
by Government during the Tenth Five Year
Plan to protect the above Island?
